idea-plugin.name: Backstage Catalog Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Visualises a Backstage catalog-info.yaml as the catalog graph it describes.

Open any catalog-info.yaml and a Backstage Catalog view appears beside the source. Every entity in the file becomes a node, every spec reference (owner, system, dependsOn, providesApis, consumesApis, subcomponentOf, parent, and the rest) becomes a labelled edge.

References that leave the file — a group owned by another repository, a system defined in the org catalog — are drawn as dashed placeholder nodes, so the picture shows both what the file defines and what it depends on.

  • Live update as you type
  • Double-click an entity to jump to its declaration
  • Zoom, pan, and neighbourhood highlighting
  • Descriptor problems reported inline instead of an empty graph
